Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 15x ki per ghost
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: 1 Minute (Concentration)
Type: omni
The user spits out a number of identical ghost
versions of themselves up to or equal to half of their
proficiency bonus.
The Ghosts float harmlessly around you for the
duration. Whenever you are subject to an attack roll you
may sacrifice a ghost to take the hit and explode,
dealing 2d6 Ki damage to all creatures but yourself
within 5 feet.
These ghosts count toward the count for the “Super
Ghost Kamikaze” Technique.
